frequency_question: How often do major energy permitting reform bills pass into law given that advance signals of bipartisan negotiations are visible?
membership_rule: Includes major omnibus or targeted energy permitting reform packages that reached active committee markup or floor consideration with bipartisan leadership backing between 2005 and 2024. Excludes minor provisions bundled into must-pass appropriations without separate substantive debate.

cases.name: Waxman-Markey ACES Act (passed House, died Senate)

coverage_note: 6 named major legislative vehicles over the past two decades capturing the primary attempts at comprehensive energy and pipeline permitting reform.
known_gaps: Excludes minor rider attachments in annual NDAA or appropriations bills that did not constitute comprehensive reform.
skeleton: 6 historical major legislative attempts at energy permitting reform with visible advance signals, yielding 3 successful enactments and 3 failures.
validity_reason: The base rate reflects polarized congressional dynamics on energy and environmental policy, which remain stable across recent legislative cycles.
